messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content:
No. Pointwise polynomial convergence [0,1] fails uniformity.

Counterexample: B_n(x) = x^n, x ∈ [0,1]. Pointwise limit: f(x) = 0, x ∈ [0,1); f(1) = 1. Discontinuous at x = 1.

Every B_n: continuous [0,1]. Uniform limit theorem: uniform convergence forces continuous limit. f: discontinuous. Contradiction.

Conclusion: B_n fails uniform convergence [0,1].
